title: OrganizerBillNoticeDocument
description: One notice to an organizer's owner that Catch issued them a bill or reminded them of it, delivered outside the app. Email goes only to the owner's verified Firebase Auth address, through the transactional email credential named in billingNoticeSettings/platform; it is an operational account notice, so no marketing consent applies. Push says only that a bill was issued, with no amount, so the native Host app stays within App Store guideline 3.1.3(f). WhatsApp from Catch to hosts is not active (docs/host_product.md) and is not sent. Each channel is attempted once per notice; a deferred email is retried by the hourly sweep. Server-only.
x-owner: Functions organizer billing (adminManageOrganizerBills send/remind, bill notice delivery)

state.description: pending: not tried yet. accepted: the provider took it. deferred: throttled; the sweep retries. noAddress: the owner has no verified email. notConfigured: billingNoticeSettings has no email credential. rejected, withheld, unknown: not retried (an unknown outcome may have been delivered).
